entities.summary: Rafa Salama was a Palestinian militant and the head of the Khan Yunis branch of the Al-Qassam Brigades, the military wing of Hamas. He was killed by the Israeli military in an airstrike on al-Mawasi refugee camp on 13 July 2024, during the Gaza war.
